data.one_liner: A lightweight widget for creating onboarding flows with customizable highlights and callbacks.
data.what_it_does: It displays a sequence of highlighted UI elements with overlay and optional child widgets. The flow can be started with `Tutorial.showTutorial` and finished with a callback or skipped with `Tutorial.skipAll`.
use_when: adding a feature walkthrough to a new screen
adding a short tutorial to a button or menu item
avoid_when: requiring deep link handling or nested routing
weaknesses: no built‑in navigation or deep link support
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package; no additional permissions or build steps required.
